name: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a Cirq program computing linear cr
task_prompt: Solve this quantum programming problem. Write a Cirq program computing linear cross-entropy benchmarking (XEB) fidelity of random single-qubit-rotation + CZ circuits on 5 qubits, depth 12, comparing a noiseless sampler against the ideal probabilities (expected XEB ≈ 1). Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
